latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — enables structured quarterly audits to detect and prevent growth stalls in growth programs.

- Audits North Star metric trends, channel concentration, and experiment cadence for early stall signals.
- Diagnoses stall patterns (complacency, channel dependency, cadence decay) using growth metrics and experiment logs.
- Prescribes specific recovery actions matched to detected stall risks.
- Generates a detailed growth-stall-risk-audit.md report each quarter.
- Designed for proactive use by growth leads/Heads of Growth in companies running mature growth operating systems.
